Yes we need GitHub login for two reasons currently:
1. Private issues. The idea is that partners can add their private repos to our directory. If you want to be able to read them, you need access via your GitHub account. Basically we have another private version of the DevPool directory backend but that's still not really well implemented. 
2. Referral tracking. When you login, we save a referral code for future referral rewards. It's pretty much the only place in our system we can do this.
